sloka: तत्पर्वताग्रमाकाशे रक्षोबाणविदारितम् ।विशीर्णं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।। ६.५६.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: tatparvatāgramākāśe rakṣobāṇavidāritam ।viśīrṇaṁ patitaṁ dṛṣṭvā hanumān krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.56.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.
